title: Nightfall Keep
description: A bite-sized survivor roguelite — pick a class, auto-attack the swarm, level up, and see how many waves you can outlast.
concept: A Vampire-Survivors-style auto-battler distilled into one HTML file: three classes with distinct weapons (melee sweep, piercing arrows, orbiting blades), a seeded wave director that scales difficulty and spawns a boss every 5th wave, and a 3-choice upgrade system on every level-up. Runs are seeded so you can challenge a friend to your exact swarm via a shareable link.
features: 3 selectable classes with distinct auto-attack weapons (sweep, piercing arrow, orbiting blades)
Seeded wave director with scaling enemy stats, 5 enemy types, and boss waves every 5th wave
Level-up system with 8 general + 3 weapon-specific upgrades, pick-1-of-3 on every level
Touch joystick for mobile + WASD/arrow keys for desktop, pause/resume
Share-seed link (URL hash) so a specific run can be replayed by others
Top-5 high score leaderboard persisted to localStorage per browser

interaction.mouse: Drag the on-screen joystick (desktop with mouse also works) to move.
interaction.click: Click class cards to select, click upgrade cards to choose a level-up.
interaction.touch: Drag anywhere in the bottom-left zone to move via virtual joystick.
interaction.keyboard: WASD / arrow keys to move, Space to pause, 1/2/3 to pick an upgrade.
